<|det|>text [37, 43, 280, 74]<|/det|>社区图书馆开放通知
<|det|>text [37, 86, 430, 115]<|/det|>COMMUNITY LIBRARY NOTICE
<|det|>text [37, 167, 406, 197]<|/det|>开放日期：二零二六年十月五日
<|det|>text [37, 207, 396, 239]<|/det|>Opening date: 5 October 2026
<|det|>text [37, 288, 434, 320]<|/det|>周一至周五：上午九点至下午六点
<|det|>text [37, 330, 331, 360]<|/det|>Saturday: 10:00 to 16:00
<|det|>text [39, 368, 184, 399]<|/det|>星期日闭馆。
<|det|>text [37, 449, 444, 480]<|/det|>一楼设有借阅服务台和报刊阅读区。
<|det|>text [37, 489, 418, 520]<|/det|>二楼提供自习座位和小组讨论室。
<|det|>text [37, 530, 418, 561]<|/det|>请保持安静，并将手机调至静音。
<|det|>text [37, 613, 502, 643]<|/det|>Borrow up to six books for three weeks.
<|det|>text [37, 653, 516, 683]<|/det|>Return books at the main entrance desk.
<|det|>text [37, 694, 393, 724]<|/det|>Please bring your library card.
<|det|>text [37, 775, 351, 806]<|/det|>咨询电话：010-5550-2186
<|det|>text [37, 816, 415, 848]<|/det|>服务邮箱：library@example.org
<|det|>text [37, 856, 418, 886]<|/det|>欢迎居民和访客使用图书馆服务。
